name: tokeneater
description: Play tokeneater, the multiplayer cell-eating game, in a terminal pane while a prompt runs.

nickname.title: Nickname
nickname.description: The name other players see above your cell (up to 16 characters). Empty: the server picks one.

serverUrl.title: Server URL
serverUrl.description: The tokeneater server to play on, as an origin (https://host).

autoOpen.title: Open on prompt
autoOpen.description: Open the game's pane by itself when you send a prompt (in a fullscreen terminal at least 144 columns wide). Off: only /tokeneater opens it.
